summary: Sporting News guide to 2023 college bowl season betting, listing upcoming bowl matchups with kickoff times, venues and broadcasters, plus results so far and the CFP semifinals (Rose Bowl, Sugar Bowl). It explains bet types (moneylines, spreads, totals, props, parlays), how to open a sportsbook account, and gives background on the New Year's Six, CFP qualification and past national champions.
one_line: Guide to 2023 NCAAF bowl season betting covering upcoming matchups, results to date, CFP semifinals, bet types, and CFP background.
key_facts: Favorites won all three games on Tuesday's triple header both straight up and ATS, and the OVER was 3-0 that day.
Through the games listed, bowl favorites are 11-11 SU and 7-15 ATS, and the Over is 13-9.
The Military Bowl (Virginia Tech vs. Tulane) kicks off 2 p.m. ET Wednesday, Dec. 27 at Navy-Marine Corps Memorial Stadium in Annapolis, MD, on ESPN.
The Duke's Mayo Bowl (UNC vs. West Virginia) is at Bank of America Stadium in Charlotte, NC, at 5:30 p.m. ET on Dec. 27.
The DIRECTV Holiday Bowl (Louisville vs. USC) is at Petco Park in San Diego at 8 p.m. ET on FOX.
The Rose Bowl semifinal pits Alabama vs. Michigan at 5 p.m. ET in Pasadena, CA; the Sugar Bowl semifinal pits Texas vs. Washington at 8:45 p.m. ET at the Caesars Superdome in New Orleans.
Recent results include USF 45, Syracuse 0 in the Boca Raton Bowl and South Alabama 59, Eastern Michigan 10 in the 68 Ventures Bowl.
The Jacksonville State vs. Louisiana-Lafayette New Orleans Bowl ended 34-31 in overtime.
The New Year's Six bowls are Rose, Sugar, Fiesta, Peach, Cotton and Orange; two rotate as CFP semifinals.
The CFP expands to a 12-team format with quarterfinal games in the 2024-25 season.
The 2023-24 national championship is Jan. 8 in Houston; 2024-25 is Jan. 20 in Atlanta; 2025-26 is Jan. 19 in Miami.
Georgia won the CFP title in both 2021-22 and 2022-23; Alabama won in 2015-16, 2017-18 and 2020-21.
The bowl season lasts three weeks and consists of 43 games, including the national championship.
In a parlay, all legs must win; payouts are larger but chances of winning are greatly reduced.
